'''Wettle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Go see Master Wettle in the temple. Doesn't look like much, but he'll show you stuff you wouldn't believe.|Hallen, to the Barsen'thor|<ref name="Wisdom of Elders" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Wettle resided at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. A heavy-set man, Wettle was a trained [[Jedi Consular]] and trained Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] in martial arts, a practice he was very knowledgeable at, according to Padawan [[Hallen (Jedi)|Hallen]]. At one point, the future [[The Barsen'thor|third Barsen'thor]] visited him.<ref name="Wisdom of Elders" />
